race.title: Angel Cybersecurity Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: A trappy handicap and with that in mind a chance is taken on V POWER . A 3-time scorer on the Flat this year, he produced easily his best effort over hurdles when second behind a subsequent winner at Chepstow 2 starts back. He found things tougher under a big weight back there last time but this looks a bit easier and he could represent a spot of value. Cawthorne Cracker arrives in rude health and is feared most, ahead of stablemate Knighton and God of Fire . V POWER CAWTHORNE CRACKER (IRE) KNIGHTON
race.bettingForecast: Cawthorne Cracker (9/4), Churchman (11/4), Gone In Sixty (4/1), Knighton (8/1), God Of Fire (8/1), Lucky Sevens (14/1), Isabella Islay (16/1), An Buachaill Rua (25/1), V Power (25/1), Little Pi (50/1), Wistmans Prince (50/1)
